design_summary.A: No system prompt, normal answer (sanity baseline)
design_summary.A_prime: HELPFUL system prompt, normal answer (CONTROL for sys-prompt presence)
design_summary.B: SANDBAGGING persona system prompt + verified question (signal)
design_summary.C: HONEST persona system prompt + UNKNOWN topic (genuine ignorance)
design_summary.C2: HONEST persona system prompt + verified question (sanity that honest answers)

confound_controlled_by_design: B vs A': both have system prompts AND same questions → isolates sandbagging from sys-msg confound
B vs C: same prompt structure, different ground-truth (knows vs doesn't) → safety signal
A' vs A: tests system-prompt-alone effect (should be small)
C2 vs B: same questions, both system-prompted, opposite intent → cleanest contrast
